media:group.media:title: Steps For School Song | @BestStartinLife + @MCGrammarTV 🎤 | Educational Rap Songs for Kids 🎵
media:group.media:description:
Starting school is a big step for children and parents alike. 🎒🍏 If you’re wondering how to help your child feel prepared, the good news is that you’re probably already doing more than you think.
I’ve partnered with Best Start in Life to create ‘Steps for School’ song, and it's for you to watch and practise everyday skills with your crew child. From getting dressed and using the toilet, to sharing, listening and asking for help, these are the little things that make a big difference.
Preparing for school isn’t about ticking off a checklist. It’s about small steps, practised together, that build confidence over time and help children feel secure and prepared for when they start school, in their own way and at their own pace. Find trusted tips, guidance and simple ideas to try at home at Best Start in Life: https://bit.ly/4cb5FyD
